boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Documented NYU Libraries study environments in and around Bobst Library, with access and reservation details noted where applicable.

cards.title: Bobst Stacks Seating
cards.subtitle: Elmer Holmes Bobst Library, 70 Washington Square South
cards.notes: Choose a partitioned desk or table in the stacks when you need quiet individual work, natural light, nearby outlets, and a library setting.
cards.short_summary: Quiet individual seating with natural light, outlets, tables, and partitioned desks.
cards.evidence_claim: Bobst Stacks Seating is designated for quiet, individual study and includes natural light, outlets, tables, and partitioned desks.
cards.access_notes: Use during Bobst open hours; consult NYU Libraries for current building access and hours.

cards.title: Bobst North Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Elmer Holmes Bobst Library, Floors 2, 4, 6, and 8
cards.notes: Head to a North Reading Room for a library-based quiet-work option; use the floor guide to select an open location before settling in.
cards.short_summary: Named reading rooms distributed across multiple upper floors of Bobst.
cards.evidence_claim: NYU Libraries’ Bobst floor guide lists North Reading Rooms on floors 2, 4, 6, and 8.
cards.source_title: Finding Your Way Around Bobst Library | NYU Libraries
cards.access_notes: Confirm current floor availability and Bobst access guidance before visiting.

cards.title: Bobst Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Elmer Holmes Bobst Library, LL1, LL2, and Floor 7
cards.notes: Reserve a room before gathering classmates, then arrive with the group ready to work through a shared assignment or presentation.
cards.short_summary: Reservable collaborative rooms available to NYU students at several Bobst levels.
cards.evidence_claim: Bobst Group Study Rooms are reservable spaces for collaborative work and are available to all NYU students.
cards.access_notes: Book through the NYU Libraries room-reservation system; availability and reservation rules apply.

cards.title: Bobst Individual Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Elmer Holmes Bobst Library, Lower Level 2
cards.notes: Reserve an LL2 individual room for a focused solo block, especially when you need more separation than open seating provides.
cards.short_summary: Reservable Lower Level 2 rooms intended for quiet, individual study.
cards.evidence_claim: Bobst Individual Study Rooms on Lower Level 2 are reservable for all NYU students and recommended for quiet, individual study.
cards.access_notes: Reserve ahead through NYU Libraries; confirm current room availability and requirements.

cards.title: Bobst Sensory-Friendly Study Pods
cards.subtitle: Elmer Holmes Bobst Library, south side of LL2
cards.notes: Reserve a soundproof pod for spoken practice, an interview, or concentrated work; bring your reservation confirmation and arrive on time.
cards.short_summary: Individual reservable pods with soundproofing, adjustable lighting, power, Wi-Fi, and ventilation.
cards.evidence_claim: Bobst’s sensory-friendly study pods are reservable individual spaces with soundproofing, adjustable lighting, power outlets, Wi-Fi, and a fan.
cards.source_title: Bobst Sensory-Friendly Study Pods | NYU Libraries
cards.access_notes: All NYU students may reserve up to three hours daily, up to 14 days ahead; a NetID and confirmation are required.

cards.title: Bobst Collaborative Media Rooms
cards.subtitle: Avery Fisher Center, Bobst Library Floor 7
cards.notes: Book a media room when your group needs a monitor, speakers, and writable surfaces for a listening, viewing, or presentation session.
cards.short_summary: Reservable Floor 7 rooms equipped for collaborative media listening and viewing.
cards.evidence_claim: The Avery Fisher Center’s Bobst collaborative media rooms have monitors, speakers, and writable walls or whiteboards for media work.
cards.source_title: Bobst Collaborative Media Rooms | NYU Libraries
cards.access_notes: Reservations are available up to 14 days ahead and may be booked for up to three hours per day; no food or drinks.

cards.title: Avery Fisher Center Media Workstations
cards.subtitle: Bobst Library Floor 7
cards.notes: Use a first-come workstation for individual media study, and ask the Avery Fisher Center desk if you need help locating materials or equipment.
cards.short_summary: Ten first-come individual workstations for listening and viewing media at Bobst.
cards.evidence_claim: The Avery Fisher Center offers 10 media workstations for individual study on a first-come, first-served basis.
cards.source_title: Bobst Collaborative Media Rooms | NYU Libraries
cards.access_notes: Workstations are first-come, first-served; check current Avery Fisher Center and Bobst hours before arrival.

cards.title: Bobst Graduate Collaboratives
cards.subtitle: Elmer Holmes Bobst Library, LL1, Floors 4 and 6
cards.notes: Graduate students can reserve a dedicated collaborative room for project work; check room availability and swipe-access requirements before planning.
cards.short_summary: Graduate-only reservable rooms for collaborative work in three Bobst locations.
cards.evidence_claim: Bobst Graduate Collaboratives are reservable, graduate student-only, swipe-access rooms for collaborative work on LL1 and floors 4 and 6.
cards.access_notes: Restricted to graduate students and requires swipe access; reserve through NYU Libraries.

cards.title: Bobst Dissertation Writers’ Rooms
cards.subtitle: Elmer Holmes Bobst Library, Floors 4, 5, and 6
cards.notes: Eligible doctoral students can apply for a dedicated scholarly workspace with a partitioned desk; contact library access staff if eligibility is unclear.
cards.short_summary: Swipe-access shared offices with partitioned desks for doctoral dissertation research.
cards.evidence_claim: Bobst Dissertation Writers’ Rooms are shared, swipe-access offices with partitioned desks for eligible PhD students.
cards.source_title: Bobst Dissertation Writers’ Rooms | NYU Libraries
cards.access_notes: Access is limited to eligible doctoral students and is swipe-controlled; application or school-provided eligibility may be required.

cards.title: Bobst First Floor Study Space
cards.subtitle: Elmer Holmes Bobst Library, Floor 1 Atrium
cards.notes: Use the updated first-floor layout for either solo coursework or a small collaborative session, choosing from its varied seating and lighting options.
cards.short_summary: A redesigned first-floor study area with individual and group seating, improved lighting, and acoustic treatments.
cards.evidence_claim: Bobst’s first-floor redesign added a study-space layout for individual and group study, new seating, improved lighting, and acoustic wall paneling.
cards.source_title: Reimagining Bobst Library’s First Floor | NYU Libraries
cards.access_notes: Use during Bobst open hours and follow current library building-access guidance.
